equation_summary: GLA keeps a matrix state h[B,H,K,V] with a per-KEY-CHANNEL, per-token data-dependent decay gate: gk = logsigmoid(gk_proj(x)) / gate_logit_normalizer has shape [B,T,H,K], and h_t = exp(gk_t) ⊗ h_{t-1} (broadcast over V) + k_t^T v_t, o_t = (q_t*scale) h_t (after-update read). This is a channel-diagonal transition G_t = diag(exp(gk_t)) acting on the K axis of the state.
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[QKV/key-channel gate]: gk_proj produces key_dim values reshaped to [H,K], i.e. per-key-channel, matching the ledger's 'key-channel gate' and 'channel-diagonal G'
CONFIRM the update is U2.A with a channel-diagonal decay: h = h*gk[...,None] + k^T v; o = (q*scale) h
CONFIRM blockers: B[channel-decay native envelope] and B[K2_graph_execution] are the correct blockers for a channel-diagonal gate
direction_justification: GLA is exactly U2.A with a channel-diagonal decay gate (key-channel scope) supplied as a data-dependent operand; the ledger already carries the channel-decay envelope blocker, so no new axis descriptor is needed.
open_questions: The channel-decay native envelope must support a [K]-diagonal transition on the state K axis; confirm the low-rank gk_proj (gate_low_rank_dim) factorization stays external and does not leak into the descriptor.
